personal.shortIntro: A Computer Science Engineering student and Full Stack Web Developer with practical experience in building live web platforms, database-driven systems, and user-focused digital solutions.
personal.bio:
I am Abhishek Kumar, a Computer Science Engineering student and Full Stack Web Developer who enjoys building real applications that people can actually use. My journey has been shaped by practical learning, self-dependency, and real project experience.

I have worked on platforms like Doc Sansar, where I learned how to handle users, content, databases, UI, verification workflows, and performance in a real environment. I believe in learning by building, improving step by step, and solving practical problems.

Currently, I am strengthening my programming fundamentals, Java knowledge, and problem-solving skills while continuing to work on real-world web applications.

caseStudies.title: Case Studies
caseStudies.subtitle: Deep-dive into how I think, plan, and build

items.title: Building Doc Sansar: From Idea to 20K+ Users
items.problem: Students often struggle to find organized study materials in one place. Existing platforms were either too complex, required payment, or didn't cater to Indian university students specifically.
items.goal: Build a platform where students can access, upload, and share academic resources easily — free, organized, and student-friendly.
items.role: I handled everything: planning, development, database structure, UI design, backend logic, upload workflow, verification system, SEO, and continuous improvement.
challenges: Organizing diverse study materials properly across categories
Handling uploads and preventing low-quality or harmful content
Making the platform easy to use for non-technical students
Improving visibility through SEO without paid tools
Maintaining performance and usability as content grew
items.solution: Built a categorized platform with upload management, admin verification workflow, file preview, search functionality, user accounts, and SEO-friendly URL and content structure.
impact: Ranked on Google within 7 days of launch
10K+ clicks in a single month through Google Search
Started generating AdSense revenue as a self-built product
items.learning: This project gave me deep practical understanding of product building, user needs, SEO, database design, content moderation, and the continuous improvement mindset needed to run a real platform.
